title: Lane keys S/B (Standard/Best-effort) and class key .One arms never driven — only .E and .Two are scripted
evidence:
app/input/mouse.odin:
		case .E:
			append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_EXPRESS}))
		case .S:
			append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_STANDARD}))
		case .B:
			append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_BEST_EFFORT}))
		case .One, .Two:
			for i in 0 ..< len(inp.cat.packet_types) {
				if k.key == Key(int(Key.One) + i) {
					append(out, Intent(Set_Class{class = u16(i)}))
--- grep of every Key_Press driven in harness/parity.odin returns only: line 429 `.Two`, 467 `.E`, 484 `.X`, 514 `.Esc`, 548 `.X`, 567 `.Esc`, 613 `.P`. No `.S`, `.B`, or `.One` appears anywhere in the suite.
detail: The brief pins the lane keys E/S/B as preserved-exactly mouse surface, but only E (express) is scripted. A swapped LANE_STANDARD/LANE_BEST_EFFORT constant or a dropped .One arm passes the parity gate silently. Twin-of-E gap, distinct from the r1-known Delete-key twin.
recommended_fix: Extend the lane scenario (or add one) pressing .S and .B and asserting the Cmd_Set_Lane lane constants; drive .One with sel_class preset 1 and assert it SETS class 0.

title: Touch placing gates are structurally unreachable in the parity harness (isolated per-device runs, no placing preset, touch has no tray)
detail: touch_map's Touch_Press placing branch and Touch_Release placing gate can never execute under test: only the mouse tray arms placement, each device's script runs in a separate fresh sim, and no scenario preset seeds placing. Distinct from the r1 same-frame mixed-device gap — cross-frame state interactions are untestable by construction.
recommended_fix: Add a `placing` preset to Parity_Scenario (seeded in drive_parity like tier/sel_pipe) and script a touch press + release while placing, asserting no draw starts and no select fires.
